column1: # Farms with no recipe map in the export (WO-4.2, plan 7.2 "Farms", D233): crop, mob and other
# farms the power designer may use as virtual recipes in a self-sustaining line. Read by
# gregtec.planner.farms only for products no DB farm map gives (GT's Tree Growth Simulator is read
# from gt.recipe.treefarm). Every number is a curator's, measured in the Lab or read from the
# machine, never estimated; cite where it came from in the note.
# Columns (tab-separated): id, name, machine (mte:<id> or empty), seconds (one operation), eut
# (EU/t while running), inputs and outputs per operation and catalysts (kept, never used up: the
# bootstrap kit's seeds, saplings or spawners) as <stable key>*<amount> joined by ';', source
# (always curated), note. Keys are registry@meta or fluid:<name>, never numeric ids.
